_comment: Shield signing keys for Dofus Retro 1.48 / Hystoria V5. This is a TEMPLATE with dummy values — copy to shield_keys.json and replace with the real keys extracted from a live client. See dofus_bot/README.md section 'Shield' for the extraction recipe.
_hash_array_comment: The 9 AES-256 keys (hex, 64 chars each) that live in the closure around Shield.applyPacketToSendPostProcessing in main.jsc. Order matters — use the order the client's Shield.init() populates them. If you only have 2 keys you can omit the others, but the signer will reject slot_k1 / slot_k2 pointing past the end.
_wrap_key_comment: The outer AES-256 key used in step 4 of the signing flow. DOCS.md mentions '2 wrap keys' in some builds — put the primary here and the alternate in wrap_key_alt (set to null if you only have one).
_static_iv_comment: The constant 16-byte IV used in steps 2 and 3 (inner AES rounds). Derived at Shield.init() time from the hash chain, stays fixed for the session.
_slots_comment: Which hash_array index to use for k1 (step 2) and k2 (step 3). Default (0, 1) matches the common pattern but may differ per build — verify against captures in data/security_api_calls.json from xkenzzo31/dofus-retro-deobfuscator.
